summary: Thunder Mountain Gold Inc. filed an 8-K on July 8, 2026, reporting two non-event items under Regulation FD and Other Events. First, the board approved issuing up to 1,578,036 common shares at $0.70 each to settle $1,104,625 in debt owed to the CEO and former service providers; this related-party transaction relies on exemptions from valuation and minority approval under Canadian MI 61-101 and remains subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval. Second, the board authorized a non-brokered private placement of units at $0.70 per unit for up to $6.4 million gross proceeds. Neither constitutes a transformative special situation; the filing is a routine disclosure of a debt settlement and capital raise with no change of control, premium, or strategic event. What to watch: exchange approval and completion conditions.
